connector.name: Creator SKILL v2 - Influencer Discovery
connector.registryDescription: SKILL-02 (not SKILL-01): AI influencer search on TikTok, Instagram & YouTube. sk_live_ token.
connector.summary: Hosted at skill.deinai.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package creator-skill-v2. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.deinai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer sk_live_ API token. Create via POST https://skill.deinai.ai/api/v1/tokens (requires sk_sess_ session from login).

env.name: SKILL_TOKEN
env.description: sk_live_ API token from Skill portal (POST /api/v1/tokens)
